originalObservations: Tall compact cluster of hollow hot-pink and violet tubes, tiered by height, rooted in a low cobalt reef base. Five major pink tubes dominate; violet adds a cooler secondary accent.

Source tubes have conspicuous flat planar sides, narrow abrupt rims and very dark interiors; straight sides and even rim thickness give a manufactured pipe feel. The mostly blank surfaces flatten at intended size.
Blue rubble shows very dark broad planes and an angular front shelf; the object remains unmistakably tube coral.
targetObservations: Target preserves the pink/violet/cobalt family while giving rounder, softly rounded rim shoulders, swelling/tapering tubes and substantial open cavities.
Warm cream-pink rim highlights and broad gentle body shading make the tubes feel fleshy and dimensional; cavities remain legible rather than becoming black voids.
Sparse oval surface pores, small blue-violet polyps and low green accents make the base feel like a living reef. These are useful design cues, not mandatory exact counts or positions.
ImageGen shape/camera/registration/light asymmetry is not source law. Bright preferred-edge glints and thin colored alpha-edge contamination are not goals.
styleReferenceObservations: The plant uses legible large forms, rounded crafted pot edges, soft broad highlights and lively controlled color. Surface detail supports rather than obscures silhouette.
